scope: Preparatory source, fixture-test and procedure review only. Public release acceptance remains unproven.

notes: The required role set is GUI plus Server. A deliberate incomplete-role override is not full-release acceptance.
The current Mac release leg cross-builds on Linux; the native Mac build is an alternate route, not an interchangeable credential contract.
GUI resource configuration includes sidecar/spa, while the Server carries runtime, dependency, source, seed and migration payloads.
Optional resources and pack exclusions still require inspection of the final assembled bytes; source/fixture checks do not establish actual offline-install completeness.
Use the existing producer and verifier chain. This review did not cut another candidate, publish artifacts, change a rig, restart runtime, or operate a live release gate.

signingInputs.observation: The default key at $HOME/.papercusp/signing/papercusp.key exists for the checking process. This process has no explicit path/password override. No private value was read and no signature was produced or verified.
signingInputs.remaining: Verify the configured updater public/private-key pairing and signatures against the exact final artifacts and manifest.

signingInputs.observation: WINDOWS_CERT_BASE64/PASSWORD are absent in this agent process. The producer decodes supplied PKCS#12 material and signs PE outputs through osslsigncode; absent certificate material selects its explicit unsigned path. This process-only observation does not establish absence in another builder or credential store.
signingInputs.remaining: Resolve an authorized certificate/private-key source outside the repository, certificate-chain validity, timestamp policy, exact installer and bundled-executable Authenticode verification, and a real quarantined/downloaded signed-install journey. No SmartScreen trust or reputation is claimed.

signingInputs.observation: Both inputs are absent in this agent process. The maintained producer supplies them to rcodesign when present and otherwise signs ad hoc. Its observed per-role call sequence is sign_app, make_updater, make_dmg. The source contains no notarization submission or stapling step.
signingInputs.remaining: Resolve an authorized Developer ID identity/private key and a maintained exact-candidate notarization/finalization workflow with its own credential contract. Prove nested-code signing, intended identity/team, hardened runtime/entitlements/timestamp as required by that workflow, accepted notary result, stapled ticket and native Gatekeeper acceptance. Rebuild downstream archives, updater signatures, hashes and provenance if finalization changes bytes.

Actual artifact hashes, updater signatures, build-provenance.json and manifest URLs/platform keys bound to the same final bytes.
Final assembled dependency/seed/migration/optional-resource audit and the real offline-install/launch journey.
Native Windows signing verification and native Mac signature, ticket and Gatekeeper verification without removing quarantine or bypassing protection.
P521 physical acceptance, independent release GO, an actual 72-hour post-GO canary, owner-freeze/refusal/recovery, the separate defaults decision, portfolio closeout and final shipment ceremonies.
